headline: A Russia-Europe security deal without ending the war first would be 'dangerous' for the EU
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM, via wire] Zelenskyy warned that any attempt to discuss a new security framework in Europe without first addressing how to end the Russia-Ukraine war could be 'dangerous' for the EU. He said he was not aware of all the details of a potential new security framework proposed by…
sources: Volodymyr Zelenskyy, CNN interview Friday Nov 6
fault_line: Security for Europe, or security for Ukraine first? Zelenskyy says a deal that skips the war is dangerous -- Europe's capitals say the war has to end before Russia's concerns get a hearing.

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM, via wire] Zelenskyy warned that any attempt to discuss a new security framework in Europe without first addressing how to end the Russia-Ukraine war could be 'dangerous' for the EU. He said he was not aware of all the details of a potential new security framework proposed by Trump but cautioned against discussions that could sideline efforts to end the war. [CONTEXT, already recorded] Ukraine, the US and Russia are preparing working-level trilateral talks within a week; Zelenskyy said Wednesday he had a detailed ~1.5-hour conversation with Witkoff and Kushner on preparations; Witkoff announced Abu Dhabi Nov 10-11; Putin confirmed the schedule Nov 6 (TASS).
sections.what_verified: 1 distinct declared-tier publisher family: ANI (T1 wire), carried by Tribune India (T3) and Republic World (undeclared carrier, same ANI family). Item is sig 2, below the >=3 two-family gate.
sections.why_matters: Zelenskyy warns Europe: a security deal that skips the war is dangerous. Three days before the Abu Dhabi table -- and the missiles are still falling on Kyiv.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- Zelenskyy (CNN interview): a Russia-Europe security deal without ending the war first would be 'dangerous' for the EU; trilateral talks within a week

totw_analysis: Our read: Zelenskyy warns Europe: a security deal that skips the war is dangerous. Three days before the Abu Dhabi table -- and the missiles are still falling on Kyiv. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Security for Europe, or security for Ukraine first? Zelenskyy says a deal that skips the war is dangerous -- Europe's capitals say the war has to end before Russia's concerns get a hearing.
